metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Passaic County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Lakeside & Colfax Section, Downtown Wanaque Ave & Cannonball District
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 4.131%, with an equalization ratio of 61.32%.
Public education represents 57.1% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 27.4%.
Average residential assessment is $285,138, producing an average annual tax bill of $11,779.05.

neighborhoods.name: Lakeside & Colfax Section
neighborhoods.character: Scenic lakeside residences along Pompton Lake and Ramapo River, quiet suburban streets, ranches, and colonials
neighborhoods.description: Picturesque lakeside community offering boating, lakefront trails, and community parks.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Subject to environmental cleanup oversight (DuPont site) and lake dredging capital reserves.

neighborhoods.name: Downtown Wanaque Ave & Cannonball District
neighborhoods.character: Historic downtown shopping district with independent restaurants, turn-of-century colonials, and multi-family homes
neighborhoods.description: Walkable business district surrounding Wanaque Avenue commercial corridor.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High local school levy share (62.2%) requiring diligent budgetary scrutiny.

equityAnalysis.summary: Pompton Lakes Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Pompton Lakes Borough, homeowners pay an average of $11,779.05 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.87% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 61.32%, assessed values average ~61.32% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 57.1% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 27.4%, and Passaic County claims 15.5%.
